serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: Never thought of you as an early bird and yet you came a little after opening.
You: It sorta happened, I’m not really planning things in advance.
Lady Annalie: That’s good, girls don’t really like stiff guys, but you better remember to prepare something for your girlfriend’s birthday and things like that.
You: Birthday?
#Annalie.Face.shocked
She’s a bot so she doesn’t really have a birthday. Date of production maybe?
Anyway, I can’t really tell her this.
#Annalie.Face.sad
Lady Annalie: Please… {{wi}}prepare something for her… {{wi}}poor thing…
You: I will, ok?!
